# Webhook

> Outbound webhooks (Discord-first) for bans, AntiCheat and guild events.

- Package: `Webhook` · Category: Moderation & safety
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Webhook")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Webhook`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/WebhookService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Webhook = GaxiaServer.Webhook
```

### Functions

- `Webhook.SetTransport(fn: (url: string, body: string) -> (boolean, number?, number?, string?)): ()`
- `Webhook.SendUrl(url: string, payload: any): boolean`
- `Webhook.Send(channel: string, payload: any): boolean`
- `Webhook.IsConfigured(channel: string): boolean`
- `Webhook.Embed(opts: EmbedOpts): Embed`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Webhook.OnSend` — `Signal<string, boolean>`
  (channel, ok) after a 2xx delivery; channel is "(url)" for SendUrl
- `Webhook.OnError` — `Signal<string, string>`
  (channel, reason) when a payload is dropped (JSON encode failure, retries exhausted)
